newsitem.title: USA: SouthFirst unit to buy consulting firm.
newsitem.headline: SouthFirst unit to buy consulting firm.

text.p: SouthFirst Bancshares Inc on Friday said its Benefit Financial Services unit would buy nearly all of the assets of Pension & Benefit Financial Services Inc for $850,000 in cash and stock.
SouthFirst said the purchase of the private, Montgomery-based employee benefits consulting firm would immediately enhance its earnings per share.
The acquisition is part of SouthFirst's overall strategy to broaden its fee-for-service banking business, it said.
No changes in Pension & Benefit's personnel are expected.
